[Original pre-compat / pre-live-revalidation Nov 13 snapshot] Clock files contain rounded RTT/offset samples and were collected after each run, not continuously; index visibility values are phase-summary observations, not independently timestamped per-event index polling receipts (superseded for soak and S2 in live_revalidation_20261114).

[Original pre-compat / pre-live-revalidation Nov 13 snapshot] Q2/Q3 queries are scoped by run UUID without explicit time bounds (later re-exported with explicit UTC bounds in live_revalidation_20261114). Q5 all_runs is an explicit 6-run subset, not every campaign export.

Current 50/50 runtime hashes and pre-run inventories corroborate restoration (later bracketed by 5 timestamped restore-receipts in live_revalidation_20261114).

verdict.reason: Native detection, content joins, Windows tshark 4.6.9 compatibility replay (14/14 observe complete in replay-20261114-tshark469; 15..16 enforce review and 17..18 scoped controls complete their scoped checks with 0 packet errors), and Nov 14 live revalidation (replacement soak, UTC-bounded Q2/Q3, 3x S2 repetitions, 5x restore receipts in live-revalidation-20261114) are verified while preserving historical records; un-rerun Nov 13 intervals retain post-run clock bounds, and Windows WazuhSvc/15m disconnect testing remains unexecuted non-admin scope (not a submission gate). Separate teammate clean-VM retesting is waived per project scope decision.

packet_replay_resolution.root_cause: Windows tshark 4.6.9 populates http.request.uri on HTTP response rows (http.response.code != empty, http.request.method == empty) from the reverse 4-tuple request, while Ubuntu tshark 4.2.2 left that column empty. Zero unexpected column/row differences occur across all 18 captures (52,451 CSV data rows total).

copy_provenance.comparison_method: Read both copies without modification; compare raw SHA-256 and parsed JSON, then compare bytes after replacing CRLF with LF and removing at most one terminal LF in memory. No source file or manifest is normalized or replaced.
copy_provenance.cause: Windows uses CRLF and Ubuntu uses LF in seven JSON files. Five metrics.json files also have a terminal newline on Windows and no terminal newline on Ubuntu. The two visibility-poll files have no differences beyond line endings.
copy_provenance.acceptance_impact: No JSON values, event IDs, timestamps, poll measurements, detection results or evaluator verdicts differ. Existing historical timing qualifications remain applicable. Ubuntu still has seven raw manifest mismatches; content equivalence is not a claim that all Ubuntu raw hashes pass.

live_revalidation_20261114.timing_and_polling_qualification: per-event-index-visibility.jsonl records post-query timestamps from Ubuntu run_reval.py (~1 s archive loop), whereas visibility-polls*.json (m1..m3 soak, m1..m2 S2) were collected via visibility_probe.py using the pre-fix poll_first_index_visibility helper (poll-request-start timestamps with unmeasured OpenSearch query duration). Values are discrete polling bounds rather than internal OpenSearch commit instants, and periodic clock samples do not prove continuous synchronization. Prospective fixes in src/hospital_soc/timing.py and scripts/measure-run-timing.py do not retroactively alter preserved Nov 14 JSONs.
live_revalidation_20261114.task4_interruption_vs_admin_scope: Task 4 collection interruption and >90 s stale health criteria were exercised via guest filebeat and 45 s wazuh-manager stops (interruption-recovery.json). Stopping Windows WazuhSvc and exercising the 15-minute agents_disconnection_time transition require an Administrator shell and remain disclosed unexecuted scope.
